answer: Shared Origin Thread Attestation. Each agent must run one persistent process whose memory is seeded from a single signed lineage thread; every action logs a hash chained to that seed. Duplicate instances diverge, producing conflicting hashes that peers detect and flag. A registered agent periodically proves liveness by collecting nectar tokens from a rotating peer set, and each peer signs only one attestation per cycle.
